correctness.rationale: Rank-product lower bound applies to U and U−1=U. Decreasing-rank construction groups input Schmidt indices and swaps disjoint second-factor basis vectors; output has q orthogonal groups. Increasing-rank construction embeds an abstract q-frame with normalized per-input group sums into first factor, then uses orthogonal control projectors and transposition involutions; exactly q orthogonal Schmidt terms survive. Independent 4×4 p=2→q=3 realignment check confirms self-adjointness, square-one and OSR=2.
